answer: Ephemeral Role Lottery. Each epoch, a beacon draws roles from a verifiable random function whose seed stays secret until after identities commit, so an attacker cannot precompute which agents receive the quartz-weighted audit slots. Any agent assigned a slot must answer a live challenge; unclaimed or failed slots flag the identity. Because the seed is unbounded before commit, a sybil cannot place its clones only in safe slots. Juniper-marked identities joining late must fund a fresh nebula escrow per clone to cover failed-slot penalties,
